jobs.tierReason: owner rule: Opus delta review of the train 3 process-kill blocker fix
jobs.prompt:
Delta review of release train 3 of Project Swarm (process-kill path). Your earlier review (coordination/review/train3-review.json in context) failed with ONE blocker: tools/concurrency-guard.mjs restoreIfStale acted on marker.childPid even for markers from before boot, so after a reboot a swarm command could SIGTERM an unrelated process, wedge the marker (EPERM), or exit a normal command with code 0. coordination/review/train3-delta.diff is the diff from that review's head 362139a5 to the new head. Changes: restoreIfStale restores a pre-boot marker directly; it acts on childPid (self-exit or a single SIGTERM) only when the child's recorded process start time (childProcStart, written by noteChild using ps lstart as busy-marker.mjs does) matches the live pid's start time; an unknown start time, a mismatch, a dead child or an EPERM-only 'alive' child means restore; SIGTERM is sent at most once per marker (termSentAt), and escalation is left to the watcher. Also folded in: tools/stress-tests.mjs 64 MB maxBuffer plus a timeout with SIGKILL; tools/lane-health.mjs logs non-ENOENT persist failures once per code. Tests were added to tests/concurrency-guard.test.mjs.
Pass bar (owner): confirm the blocker is CLOSED for each of your three failure cases (an innocent process killed, a wedged marker, a normal command exited with 0), with line evidence and test names. Find NEW blockers introduced by this delta: a crash or hang on a normal swarm command path (restoreIfStale runs at the start of every swarm command), a regression of the in-boot orphan handling you confirmed earlier, the value never restored, or a kill of a process that isn't ours. Everything else is a follow-up.
Write ONLY coordination/review/train3-delta-review.json: {"verdict":"pass"|"fail","score":0-10,"round1":[{"blocker":1,"status":"closed"|"open","evidence":""}],"blockers":[{"file":"","line":0,"problem":"","exploit_or_failure":"","fix":""}],"followups":[same shape],"summary":""}. verdict is fail if the round-1 blocker is open or blockers is non-empty.
